clusters.name: Walter's move across the country, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, her distance from Walter as he worked long hours, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, Walter and June's rows over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir with her anxiety easing and functioning rising by September 1953. The shifts pile up across a year and a half, each one near another's in time.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard failing in May 1968 when the late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter's heavy drinking within weeks, conflict between Walter and Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian's overfunctioning as they took over the family's money and dealings with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, your bed-wetting at age eight in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found and her stop from work in May, and Walter stopping drinking and taking work pruning in October. The shifts fall close together around the auction and move to Ridgeport in October 1968, with functioning and symptoms shifting across six months.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work and sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night while Glen was unemployed, your stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, your distance from Marian as you kept to your room, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and your eating again and making the track team by June 1976 once Glen started driving a delivery truck in March. The shifts pile up across the spring and summer of 1975 and into early 1976, with your own trouble and your parents' conflict and overfunctioning near one another in time.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into your house in January 1990 when she sold her farm: clashes with you over the children's bedtimes and meals, your distance from Sam as he worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows, Sam taking his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool in June, Wilma taking over Lily's care in August, your eczema flaring on both hands in September, rows with Sam most nights by November, and your eczema clearing over the summer of 1991 once Wilma took a flat in town in June. The shifts run alongside one another from spring through the following spring, with conflict, distance and overfunctioning moving through the household around Wilma's presence.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess drinking most nights from October 1996: your phoning her every night and worrying for her by November, shouting matches between Tess and Rick by March 1997 with Rick sleeping at his brother's for a month, and Tess stopping drinking and going to meetings twice a week by June 1997. Your anxiety rises and Marian's overfunctioning with Tess—paying her rent and keeping Jesse most weekends—sits among the shifts in these months, with all movements settling once Tess's functioning comes up.
